design_vision.vibe: Rustic farmhouse aesthetic with a high-end editorial feel.
design_vision.color_palette_description: Dominant warm brown palette (deep coffee, saddle, caramel, cocoa, terracotta) with cream/ivory/off-white backgrounds.

styles.h1_hero: font-['Instrument_Serif'] italic text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#2D1C11]
styles.h2_section: font-['Instrument_Serif'] text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#2D1C11]
styles.body_large: font-['Work_Sans'] text-lg sm:text-xl font-light leading-relaxed text-[#5C4033]
styles.label: font-['Work_Sans'] text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#8B5A2B]

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8

hero_background.description: Farm video background for the hero section.

loading_screen.description: Custom counter loading screen going from 000 to 100 before fading out.
loading_screen.animation: GSAP/Framer Motion counter text with staggered fade out.

navbar.style: Floating glassmorphism pill with brand monogram.
navbar.layout: Fixed top, z-50, centered or full width depending on screen size, utilizing the glass_pill surface style.

hero.description: Hero section with farm video background, italic display name reveal ('Freeland Family Farms'), and rotating role-style word ('A {heritage/family/craft} dairy lives in California').
hero.overlay: bg-[#FDFBF7]/30 to maintain a light, rustic look without being too dark.

our_story.description: Highlights Portuguese roots. Use parallax columns and the vintage tools/baker images.

products.description: Bento grid of products (milk, sourdough, cheeses) with prices.
products.style: Card surfaces with warm brown borders, hover lift effects.

sustainability.description: Grid detailing animal welfare and farming practices.

journal_blog.style: Horizontal pill cards, minimal and elegant.

footer.description: Marquee footer saying 'FROM OUR FARM TO YOUR TABLE' in large Instrument Serif italic. Includes contact form and newsletter.

animations.scroll_reveal: GSAP timeline reveals for all sections, triggering when in view. Elements move up slightly and fade in.
animations.parallax: Use on images in the Our Story section to create depth on scroll.
animations.halftone_overlay: Apply a subtle SVG noise/halftone filter over images for a rustic editorial texture.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors (#2D1C11, #5C4033) against backgrounds (#FDFBF7, #F5F0E6) meet WCAG AA.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) must include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes matching the hex codes.
Implement Instrument Serif and Work Sans via standard imports (Google Fonts).
Use Framer Motion or GSAP for the custom counter and scroll reveals.
Follow the specific layout constraints and grid bento classes.
Avoid using any 'dark mode' logic or styles. Ensure the video overlay is light enough.
Use HTML video element with autoPlay loop muted playsInline for the background.
